// The parser's golden corpus: one Go-quoted message per line. The parsed
// form, or the error, is pinned in messages.golden; regenerate with
// go test ./internal/i18n -run TestParseGolden -update.

// Plain text, quoting and characters that are only sometimes syntax.
"Sign in"
""
"It’s ready"
"It''s ready"
"It's ready"
"'{literal}' and '}' and '#' and '<b>'"
"An unterminated quote '{runs to the end"
"a < b and 3 <= 4"
"Issue #4"
"{count, plural, other {#'#' and #}}"

// Arguments.
"Hello {name}"
"{ name }"
"{a}{b}"

// The examples of docs/I18N.md §3.
"{members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, {owners, plural, one {# owner} other {# owners}}"
"{keys, plural, =0 {Removed {name} from the organisation.} one {Removed {name} from the organisation. The API key they created was revoked.} other {Removed {name} from the organisation. The # API keys they created were revoked.}}"
"Keys let your applications call the inference API at <code>{endpoint}</code>{org, select, none {.} other { on behalf of {org}.}}"

// Plural and select structure.
"{count, plural, zero {z} one {o} two {t} few {f} many {m} other {x}}"
"{count,plural,=0{none}=1{one exactly}other{#}}"
"{n, plural, other {{g, select, a {# in a} other {# elsewhere}}}}"
"{g, select, a {no # here} other {{n, plural, other {# here}}}}"

// Tags.
"<b>Bold</b>, <em>emphasis</em>, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <code>x</code>"
"Read <link>the docs</link> or <link2>the guide</link2>."
"<b><em>nested</em></b>"

// Errors.
"Hello {name"
"Hello }"
"{}"
"{n, number}"
"{n, plural, one {x}}"
"{n, plural, other {x} other {y}}"
"{n, plural, several {x} other {y}}"
"{n, plural, offset:1 other {x}}"
"{n, select, =1 {x} other {y}}"
"<b>bold"
"<b>bold</em>"
"<strong>x</strong>"
"<a href=\"/\">x</a>"
"{n, plural, other {<b>x}}"
